text:
violet: Quick sync 1: found inconsistent param names across docs/SDKs: some examples use `model_variant`, others `modelName`, others `model`. This will trip up migrations.
ash: Ugh. Which files?
violet: examples in /docs/reference/sdk/js, /docs/reference/sdk/python, and /docs/guides/migration. Small fix but needs coordination.
patrick: Proposal: standardize on `model` (matches REST). Put variant suffix in the value, e.g., `redwood/guanaco-7b-q4`.
violet: Agreed. Also add a two-sentence glossary note distinguishing family/variant/profile and a one-line migration hint.
ash: I'll update JS snippets (`modelName` -> `model`) and add `// include variant in value` comment.
patrick: I'll handle the Python examples and add a changelog line.
docs-bot: Linkcheck queued for branch docs/param-unify-1815. Found 1 broken link in /docs/guides/migration.md -> https://old.example.com/migrate (404).
violet: Replace with `/docs/guides/migration#migrating-params`. Also tone note: change "you must" -> "we recommend" unless it's an actual breaking removal.
ash: Will push JS PR and tag @patrick.
patrick: Pushing Python PR now. I'll also add glossary blurb: "model family: base name (e.g., guanaco-7b). variant: suffixes like -q4. profile: serving config (e.g., low-latency). Example: model='redwood/guanaco-7b-q4'"
docs-bot: CI will rerun links/lint after merges.
violet: Thanks all 1! Closing after PRs merge.
